variants.prompt: REFORM SCENE/SETTING: A striking young woman stands confidently on the deck of a sleek, black yacht, the warm glow of sunset casting long shadows across her porcelain skin. The ocean stretches out behind her, its gentle waves meeting the horizon at a perfect line. In the foreground, the yacht's polished rail and the woman's scuffed combat boots create a striking contrast. A shallow depth of field blurs the background, emphasizing her bold, edgy pose.
